channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: U.P. International Trade Show 2026 set to position State as Global Sourcing hub, says Minister
item.description: UPITS 2026 will bring businesses, manufacturers, exporters and buyers together on a common platform, expand market access for local enterprises and create new avenues for investment, business growth and employment generation, said Bhupendra Chaudhary

item.title: ‘Enter at own risk’: churches to non-Christians as anti-conversion law takes effect in Chhattisgarh
item.description: Warning boards have been put up as a precautionary measure to avoid action under the Chhattisgarh Freedom of Religion Act, 2026, says Diamond Philus, general secretary of the Dhamtari District Christian Forum

item.title: Adani promises ₹1 lakh crore investment in West Bengal by 2035, looks to diversify in power generation and transmission

item.title: Veeramani case: two IPS officers shunted out, placed on compulsory wait

Kannan, Commissioner of Police, Coimbatore, were at the helm of the Chennai Police Commissionerate when a complaint accusing Gem Granites owner R. Veeramani of indulging in predatory sexual behaviour targetting minor girls first surfaced

item.title: Supreme Court restricts stay of Allahabad HC order against Gautam Buddha Nagar DM to strictures, costs
item.description: The top court’s interim order has come on an appeal against the High Court’s order quashing the detention of a student under National Security Act and directing payment of ₹5 lakh to the student, to be recovered from the salaries of the DM and other officials involved

item.title: Krishna Byre Gowda turns tables on Opposition with Manmohan Singh reference
Karnataka teachers welcome proposed law limiting teachers to non-academic activities

item.description: The implementation of a health insurance scheme with an enhanced insurance cover of ₹25 lakh had been one of the main poll promises of the UDF

item.title: Karnataka willing to share loan waiver burden if Centre announces it: D.K. Shivakumar
item.description: Amid a demand by the Opposition Bharatiya Janata Party and the Janata Dal (Secular) for announcement of farm loan waiver by the Karnataka government, Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said that the State was willing to share the financial burden of loan waiver if the Union government makes such an announcement

item.title: FSSAI proposes draft amendment to ensure only milk-derived products are represented as ‘Paneer’
item.description: The proposed Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Amendment Regulations, 2026 seek to insert a new clause under Regulation 2.1.1 of the existing regulations, specifically covering “paneer made of constituents not derived from milk”

item.title: Assam Cabinet approves Rules for compulsory Muslim marriage registration
item.description: Rules operationalise registration framework stipulated under 2024 law that replaced colonial-era legislation; new law sets age requirements for marriage, replaces licensed qazis with government registrars

item.title: If I were pardoned one murder, first person I would shoot is Gyanesh Kumar: VIP chief Mukesh Sahani on CEC
item.description: At a press conference, he points out that as law-abiding citizens one would not commit such an extreme act; he says Election Commission has turned into an arm of the BJP and that Gyanesh Kumar should have some shame
